title: lens orientalis
intro: Lens orientalis, commonly known as Indian kidney bean or Red lentil bean, is a plant species native to the mountainous regions of the Himalayas. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lens orientalis include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve blood sugar control, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Lens orientalis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and polyphenols, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiotonic effects.
